meta.title: An approver approves and the award completes
gaps: Start with a submitted proposal awaiting approval; the prepared proposal is a draft.
Sign in as the approver, open the approval task, and approve the proposal.
Verify that approval selects the proposal and changes the event state to awarded.
Verify that the final awarded vendor and quantity match the proposal allocation after approval.

steps.note: Open the required prepared event, which has a draft award proposal rather than a submitted proposal.
Check the available vendor identity against the API; this does not establish that the vendor has been awarded.
Record the available buyer-side state for inspection; approval and its resulting award state remain untested.
